purpose: The long project plan: context, honest assessment, technical choices, domains (rekenen, Taal, Frans), learning process, timer, repeat, accounts and exams, avatar and shop, security, later plans, next-year levels, publishing, the father's decision log and the phase tables.
details: Trimmed on 16/11/2026 from 957 to about 715 lines: obsolete status text and old menu/architecture chapters were removed; chapters for later work (French, adventure, shop, publishing) stay as plans. The direction and order are in koers.md, the open items in todo.md, working notes in werk/. The phase tables 'Klaar' (done versions 0.1 ...) and 'Nog te doen' are at the end. Parts describing future features are plans, not facts about the code.
summary: Master plan. Context and honest assessment; technical choices (Python 3.10+, stdlib, curses, SQLite tables); randomised questions with history; diagnosis of thinking errors; the four learning steps; interactive models (fraction bar, hundred-square, treasure map, clock); word problems with klad; Taal and French plans; timers; repeat after a series; accounts, parent area, reports and exams; points, avatar and shop; security; later subjects; next school year levels shifting along via learning lines; publishing and free-for-all; parked coach part; the father's decision log; and the tables of finished phases and the phases still to do.
